Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer incorrectly stated that the death place listed on ThePeerage.com was "Weston Park, Staffordshire, England." However, the text visible in the viewport for ThePeerage.com (which shows the entry for his mother, Hon. Lucy Elizabeth Byng, and lists her death place as "Park Lane, London, England") does not actually display the death place for George Bridgeman, 2nd Earl of Bradford. The specific line for the 2nd Earl only shows "d. 22 Mar 1865" without a location in the visible text. The WebSurfer likely hallucinated the location "Weston Park" based on the Wikipedia snippet visible in the previous turn (which mentioned "Weston Park" as the family seat and "Weston-under-Lizard" as the death place) rather than extracting the actual data from ThePeerage. This created a false consensus between sources, leading to the confusion between "Weston Park" and "Weston-under-Lizard" in the final analysis.
